title: Figure 58: Radar target geometries, descriptions and maximum RCS formulas
description: Table of line drawings pairing five reflector geometries with their maximum radar cross section formulas and comments: square trihedral corner reflector ("Strongest radar return due to triple reflection of incident wave"), right dihedral corner reflector, flat plate, right circular cylinder, and sphere (σ = πa², "Produces the same isotropic return in all directions"). Each drawing shows incident wave angles θ and φ. The caption reads "Figure 58. Geometry, Description and Maximum RCS (Aerospaceweb.org, 2010)" (BAASS report page 88).
